name: Orca
summary: Orca is the next-gen IDE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop and mobile.

highlights: Run Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Antigravity, or OpenCode side-by-side across repos — each in its own worktree, tracked in one place..
Orca supports any CLI agent (not just this list).
No login required — Bring your own Claude Code, Codex, Grok, or Antigravity subscription.
Multi-agent terminals — Run multiple AI agents side-by-side in tabs and panes.
Built-in source control — Review AI-generated diffs, make quick edits, and commit without leaving Orca.
SSH support — Connect to remote machines and run agents on them directly from Orca.
Notifications — Know when an agent finishes or needs attention.
